column1: # Channel name cleanup corpus (docs/05 "Channel name cleanup", ADR-013).
# One case per line: provider name <TAB> name shown <TAB> badge (SD, HD,
# FHD, 4K, or - for none). Real-shaped names, as panels write them. Lines
# starting with # are comments. Invisible characters are written as the
# docs/05: leading country and language tags
# A first word with no separator is the name's own
# docs/05: trailing quality tags become the badge
UK: Sky Sports Premier League UHD
# Resolutions written as lines, and the highest of several
# Technical tags stay (they tell two feeds of one channel apart)
UK: Sky Sports F1 FHD HEVC
# Kept: a timeshift, numbers, capitals, punctuation that is the name's
# Only whole words at the edges
# docs/05: entities decoded, double-escaped ones too
# Nothing left but tags: the provider's name, with no badge
